# http2py

> Tools to create python binders to http web services.


## Pages

- [http2py: (Http) requests for humans](index.html.md): &#42;&#42;Note: A new, lighterweight, more modern replacement: ho&#42;&#42;
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;http2py&#96;   | Tools to make python objects that facade http requests.   |
- [http2py](_autosummary/http2py.html.md): Tools to make python objects that facade http requests.
- [http2py.api_pkg_maker](_autosummary/http2py.api_pkg_maker.html.md): Generate an installable python package from an OpenAPI specification.
- [http2py.authentication](_autosummary/http2py.authentication.html.md): Resolve credentials and build the auth callables that requests will use.
- [http2py.cli_maker](_autosummary/http2py.cli_maker.html.md): Turn an http-bound python object into a command line interface.
- [http2py.client](_autosummary/http2py.client.html.md): The main entry point: a python object facading an http service.
- [http2py.constants](_autosummary/http2py.constants.html.md): Content-type strings shared across the request and response machinery.
- [http2py.decorators](_autosummary/http2py.decorators.html.md): Response handling: map http status codes to exceptions, decode the payload.
- [http2py.default_configs](_autosummary/http2py.default_configs.html.md): Default output transformations used when a method spec does not supply one.
- [http2py.example_cli](_autosummary/http2py.example_cli.html.md): A tiny worked example of the CLI-making tools, used by the docs and by hand.
- [http2py.global_state](_autosummary/http2py.global_state.html.md): Process-wide state (notably the shared &#96;requests&#96; session) for the clients.
- [http2py.http2py_cls](_autosummary/http2py.http2py_cls.html.md): (Http) Requests for humans
- [http2py.py2request](_autosummary/http2py.py2request.html.md): Won’t show the details here, but if you are used to it’s not that hard,
- [http2py.testing_utils](_autosummary/http2py.testing_utils.html.md): Helpers for testing code that talks to an http service.
- [http2py.util](_autosummary/http2py.util.html.md): Small general-purpose helpers: data files, dict defaults, JSON-ability checks.
